about: The Workbench icons of the Freegish drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is upstream's icons/freegish.png. Freegish-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Freegish.info beside the program. ReadMe.info is also copied for the licences; Folder.info for datapacks.
